objective.statement: Change the page title colour to turquoise.

complexity.rationale: A styling-class change on three static h1 headings; no logic, state, API or dependency change.

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The page title (h1) renders in turquoise.
Assumed: the colour applies to the h1 title of every view (Home, About, Contact) so titles stay consistent.
Assumed: turquoise is the CSS named colour turquoise (#40E0D0), applied identically in light and dark mode.

in.statement: className of the h1 in src/views/home/HomeView.tsx, src/views/about/AboutView.tsx and src/views/contact/ContactView.tsx.

out.statement: Theme tokens, ThemePicker behaviour, other headings (h3), body text, new dependencies and any other styling.

observations.statement: Each view renders an h1 with className 'text-2xl font-semibold' and no colour class; the colour is inherited from the theme.
The card says 'the page title' without naming a page; all three view h1 elements are treated as page titles. Conservative alternative: Home only.

Turquoise is expressed as a Tailwind arbitrary-value class (text-[#40E0D0]) rather than a new theme token, to avoid touching the theme system. Contrast against light surfaces is low and is not addressed by this card.

provenance.source: Card: Bug Fix - Change the page title colour. Change it to turquoise.
Conservative planning decision by the delivery engineer; the card leaves it open.

approvals.requirement: The owner must approve the plan before any test or production file is written.

decisions.rationale: Awaiting owner approval of the plan; the run stops at the planned gate.

component.rationale: Behaviour is the rendered heading's colour class, checked per view.

integration.rationale: No cross-module interaction changes; existing suite guards regressions.

e2e.rationale: Static styling of a heading; no new user flow.

increments.behavior: Each view's h1 title renders with the turquoise colour class.
increments.doneWhen: Component tests for Home, About and Contact titles pass and the existing suite stays green.

tests.description: The h1 title of HomeView, AboutView and ContactView has the turquoise colour class (text-[#40E0D0]).

expectedRedEvidence.expectedFailure: Assertion fails because the h1 has no turquoise colour class.

verification.requirement: npm run test:component passes, then the full suite (npm run test) passes once at the checkpoint.
